verses.text: ‘Look, I’ve personally chosen Bezalel son of Uri, grandson of Hur, from Judah’s tribe. 👀
I’ve filled him with God’s Spirit—with wisdom, understanding, knowledge, and skill for every kind of craft. 🧠
He can design beautiful work in gold, silver, and bronze, 🎨
cut stones for settings, carve wood, and handle every kind of skilled work. 💎
I’ve also assigned Oholiab son of Ahisamach, from Dan’s tribe, to work with him. I’ve given skill to every wise-hearted craftsperson too, so they can make everything I commanded you: 🛠️
the Meeting Tent, the covenant chest, its atonement cover, and all the Tent’s furnishings; ⛺
the table and its utensils, the pure gold lampstand and all its accessories, and the incense altar; 🕯️
the burnt-offering altar with all its utensils, plus the basin and its stand; 🫙
the finely made garments—the sacred clothes for Aaron the priest, and the clothes his sons wear while serving as priests; 👘
and the anointing oil and fragrant incense for the holy place. They must make everything just as I commanded you.’ 🫙
‘Tell Israel: Keep my Sabbaths. They’re a sign between me and you through every generation, so you’ll know I am Yahweh, the one who makes you holy.’ 🕊️
‘Keep the Sabbath; it’s holy to you. Anyone who treats it as ordinary must be put to death. Whoever works that day must be cut off from their people. ⚠️
‘Work six days. The seventh is a Sabbath—a day of complete rest, holy to Yahweh. Anyone who works on the Sabbath must be put to death. 🕯️
‘Israel must keep the Sabbath through every generation, honoring it as a lasting covenant. 📜
‘It’s a permanent sign between me and Israel. Yahweh made heaven and earth in six days; on the seventh day he stopped and was refreshed.’ 🌌
When Yahweh finished speaking with Moses on Mount Sinai, he gave him the two covenant tablets—stone tablets written by God’s own finger. 🪨
